title: Committee of Supply debate on the Ministry of Social and Family Development budget
what_it_is: A Committee of Supply debate on the Ministry of Social and Family Development budget, opened by Mr Xie Yao Quan moving a $100 reduction to Head I of the Estimates, with MPs raising policy asks and ministers setting out MSF plans.
why_it_matters: The transcript sets out changes including a new $500 quarterly Partnership Payout for all ComLink+ families, a rise in the Student Care Fee Assistance income threshold from $4,500 to $6,500 benefiting around 13,000 students, and from January 2027 a higher gross monthly household income ceiling of $15,000 for childcare and Kindergarten Fee Assistance. It also states that from July 2026 subsidies for residential and community disability services will rise by up to 15 and 10 percentage points, and that filing Form 1 of an LPA will be free for citizens.

key_points.point: Mr Xie Yao Quan moved a $100 reduction to Head I of the Estimates.
key_points.speaker: Mr Xie Yao Quan
key_points.quote: That the total sum allocated to Head I of the Estimates be reduced by $100.

key_points.point: Mr Xie Yao Quan said relative social mobility in Singapore has been slowing even as broad-based progress continued.
key_points.speaker: Mr Xie Yao Quan
key_points.quote: relative social mobility in Singapore has been slowing even as we sustained broad-based progress for all.

key_points.point: Mr Xie Yao Quan urged the Government to build a longitudinal dataset on social mobility.
key_points.speaker: Mr Xie Yao Quan
key_points.quote: I urge the Government to consider constructing such a dataset, investing in such a longitudinal dataset

key_points.point: Mr Kenneth Tiong Boon Kiat asked whether section 12 of the Mental Capacity Act could be amended to allow accredited organisations as personal welfare donees.
key_points.speaker: Mr Kenneth Tiong Boon Kiat
key_points.quote: will MSF consider amending section 12 to allow accredited organisations to serve as personal welfare donees?

key_points.point: Ms Sylvia Lim said the LPA registration fee for non-citizens and non-permanent residents is fixed at $230.
key_points.speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim
key_points.quote: The registration fee for non-citizens and non-permanent residents is currently fixed at $230.

key_points.point: Mr Gabriel Lam asked whether MSF tracks long-term economic mobility outcomes for single-parent households.
key_points.speaker: Mr Gabriel Lam
key_points.quote: Does MSF track long-term economic mobility outcomes specifically for single-parent households?

key_points.point: Mr Melvin Yong Yik Chye said unwed parents do not receive the Baby Bonus cash gift and are not eligible for certain tax benefits.
key_points.speaker: Mr Melvin Yong Yik Chye
key_points.quote: Currently, unwed parents do not receive the Baby Bonus cash gift, and they are not eligible for tax benefits

key_points.point: Mr Kenneth Tiong Boon Kiat called for funding to follow the child rather than the school.
key_points.speaker: Mr Kenneth Tiong Boon Kiat
key_points.quote: First, fund the child, not the school.

key_points.point: Ms Eileen Chong Pei Shan said the Workers' Party recommends extending childcare leave on a per child basis up to age 12.
key_points.speaker: Ms Eileen Chong Pei Shan
key_points.quote: The Workers' Party recommends extending childcare leave on a per child basis up to age 12.

key_points.point: Ms Sylvia Lim repeated her call to extend citizen rates to children in adoption cases where both parents are Singaporeans.
key_points.speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim
key_points.quote: I would like to repeat my call to MSF to extend citizen rates to those children, especially when both parents are Singaporeans.

key_points.point: Dr Neo Kok Beng said there is a real shortage of foster parents.
key_points.speaker: Dr Neo Kok Beng
key_points.quote: there is a real shortage of foster parents.

key_points.point: Ms Diana Pang Li Yen urged MSF to apply the co-parenting programme more equally to all parents undergoing divorce with children under 21.
key_points.speaker: Ms Diana Pang Li Yen
key_points.quote: I therefore urge MSF to consider applying the programme more equally to all parents undergoing divorce with children under 21 years old.

key_points.point: Miss Rachel Ong asked what safeguards protect families, children and vulnerable persons from harmful uses of AI.
key_points.speaker: Miss Rachel Ong
key_points.quote: what safeguards are in place to protect families, especially children and vulnerable persons, from harmful uses of AI?

key_points.point: Mr Sanjeev Kumar Tiwari asked how MSF is strengthening integrated support services for caregivers.
key_points.speaker: Mr Sanjeev Kumar Tiwari
key_points.quote: can the Minister share how MSF is strengthening integrated support services for caregivers?

key_points.point: Mr Melvin Yong Yik Chye welcomed this year's ComLink+ enhancements, including new payouts and smaller milestones.
key_points.speaker: Mr Melvin Yong Yik Chye
key_points.quote: I therefore welcome this year's enhancements to ComLink+, including new payouts, smaller, but more achievable milestones and cash incentives.

key_points.point: Mr Cai Yinzhou asked how MSF considers lower-income families when developing screen time policies.
key_points.speaker: Mr Cai Yinzhou
key_points.quote: I would like to ask the Ministry how it specifically considers the needs and context of lower-income families and work with other agencies to provide additional support when developing screen time policies

key_points.point: Ms Mariam Jaafar asked whether agencies could move towards one shared progression plan for families.
key_points.speaker: Ms Mariam Jaafar
key_points.quote: Could we move towards one shared progression plan across agencies – one dashboard, one set of goals, one coordinated journey?

key_points.point: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng called for disability funding reforms based on a lifespan approach.
key_points.speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng
key_points.quote: We therefore need funding reforms based on a lifespan approach.

key_points.point: Ms Kuah Boon Theng said the announced 500 additional DAC places by 2030 will not come close to fulfilling actual demand.
key_points.speaker: Ms Kuah Boon Theng
key_points.quote: while it has been announced that another 500 DAC places will be available by 2030, I firmly believe that this will not even come close to fulfilling the actual demand.

key_points.point: Prof Kenneth Poon asked whether there is a consistent anticipatory framework for planning continuity of care and participation of PwDs.
key_points.speaker: Prof Kenneth Poon
key_points.quote: Do we have a consistent anticipatory framework for planning the continuity of care and participation of PwDs?

key_points.point: Mr Ng Chee Meng asked what practical strategies will support families with PwDs, especially after schooling.
key_points.speaker: Mr Ng Chee Meng
key_points.quote: what practical strategies will be looked into to better support our families with PwDs, especially those who have graduated from the schooling system?

key_points.point: Miss Rachel Ong asked how to expand the pool of Singapore Sign Language trained counsellors and integrate sign language support into mainstream mental health services.
key_points.speaker: Miss Rachel Ong
key_points.quote: how can we expand the pool of Singapore Sign Language trained counsellors and integrate sign language competent support into mainstream mental health services?

key_points.point: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M said MSF aims to support all families at every stage of life.
key_points.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
key_points.quote: MSF aims to foster a Singapore society where all families are supported at every stage of their life to thrive on their terms.

key_points.point: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M said Healthier SG enrolment will be extended to eligible ComLink+ residents aged 25 to 39 from 2027.
key_points.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
key_points.quote: From 2027, MOH will extend Healthier SG enrolment to eligible ComLink+ residents age 25 to 39.

key_points.point: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M said family counselling capacity will double by 2030 to serve 12,000 cases.
key_points.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
key_points.quote: By 2030, we will be able to serve 12,000 cases, double of today's caseload.

key_points.point: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M said DBS has pledged up to $1 billion and 1.5 million employee volunteer hours over the next decade.
key_points.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
key_points.quote: DBS has pledged up to $1 billion and 1.5 million employee volunteer hours over the next decade

key_points.point: Mr Zhulkarnain Abdul Rahim said MSF is going beyond social assistance to social empowerment.
key_points.speaker: Mr Zhulkarnain Abdul Rahim
key_points.quote: We are going beyond social assistance to social empowerment by supporting our families through three things.

key_points.point: Mr Zhulkarnain Abdul Rahim said all ComLink+ families will receive a new $500 quarterly payout.
key_points.speaker: Mr Zhulkarnain Abdul Rahim
key_points.quote: all ComLink+ families will now receive a new payout of $500 each quarter.

key_points.point: Mr Zhulkarnain Abdul Rahim said employment milestones will consider the whole family's efforts rather than each person's income.
key_points.speaker: Mr Zhulkarnain Abdul Rahim
key_points.quote: For employment, we will look at the whole family's efforts, rather than the income of each person.

key_points.point: Mr Zhulkarnain Abdul Rahim said a ComLink+ family with two preschool-aged children can receive up to $10,000 a year under certain conditions.
key_points.speaker: Mr Zhulkarnain Abdul Rahim
key_points.quote: a ComLink+ family with two preschool-aged children can receive up to $10,000 every year by maintaining a household income of at least $2,000 and regular preschool attendance.

key_points.point: Mr Zhulkarnain Abdul Rahim said MSF will raise the Student Care Fee Assistance income threshold from $4,500 to $6,500.
key_points.speaker: Mr Zhulkarnain Abdul Rahim
key_points.quote: MSF will increase the Student Care Fee Assistance income threshold from $4,500 to $6,500 and update the income tiers.

key_points.point: Mr Zhulkarnain Abdul Rahim said ComLink+ individuals aged 18 to 39 in full-time education or vocational training will receive support for basic living expenses.
key_points.speaker: Mr Zhulkarnain Abdul Rahim
key_points.quote: When ComLink+ individuals aged 18 to 39 undergo full-time education or vocational training, they will receive support for basic living expenses.

key_points.point: Mr Eric Chua said a further 520 DAC and 360 SW spaces will come on stream progressively by 2027.
key_points.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
key_points.quote: A further 520 DAC and 360 SW spaces will come on stream progressively by 2027.

key_points.point: Mr Eric Chua said subsidies for residential and community disability services will increase from July 2026.
key_points.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
key_points.quote: From July 2026, we will increase subsidies for residential and community disability services by up to 15 and 10 percentage points respectively.

key_points.point: Mr Eric Chua said families with per capita household income up to $3,600 can receive matching top-ups of up to $10,000 to Special Needs Trust accounts from 1 April this year to 31 March 2031.
key_points.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
key_points.quote: From 1 April this year till 31 March 2031, families with per capita household income of up to $3,600 can sign up to receive matching top-ups of up to $10,000 to the SNT accounts.

key_points.point: Mr Goh Pei Ming said filing Form 1 of the Lasting Power of Attorney will be free for citizens.
key_points.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
key_points.quote: we will make it free of charge for citizens to file Form 1 of the Lasting Power of Attorney (LPA).

key_points.point: Mr Goh Pei Ming said feedback on professional donees and deputies will be considered in an upcoming review of the Mental Capacity Act and the Professional Deputies and Donees Scheme.
key_points.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
key_points.quote: We will consider them in our upcoming review of the Mental Capacity Act and the Professional Deputies and Donees Scheme.

key_points.point: Mr Goh Pei Ming said there are now enough full-day preschool places nationally for every resident child aged three and above.
key_points.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
key_points.quote: We now have enough full-day preschool places nationally for every resident child aged three and above.

key_points.point: Mr Goh Pei Ming said full-day childcare fees have been reduced to a maximum of $610 at Anchor Operator preschools and $650 at Partner Operator preschools.
key_points.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
key_points.quote: full-day childcare fees have been further reduced to a maximum of $610 at Anchor Operator preschools and $650 at Partner Operator preschools

key_points.point: Mr Goh Pei Ming said from January 2027 the gross monthly household income ceiling for the Additional Subsidy for childcare and Kindergarten Fee Assistance will rise to $15,000.
key_points.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
key_points.quote: From January 2027, we will raise the gross monthly household income ceiling for the Additional Subsidy for childcare and Kindergarten Fee Assistance Scheme to $15,000.

key_points.point: Mr Goh Pei Ming said this will improve preschool affordability for more than 60,000 lower- and middle-income families.
key_points.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
key_points.quote: This will further improve affordability of preschools for more than 60,000 lower- and middle-income families with young children.

key_points.point: Mr Goh Pei Ming said the early education workforce will grow by another 3,500 educators by 2030.
key_points.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
key_points.quote: We will grow our early education workforce by another 3,500 educators by 2030 to meet sector needs.

key_points.point: Mr Goh Pei Ming said the Taskforce on Assurance for Families with Persons with Disabilities will release its report later this year.
key_points.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
key_points.quote: The Taskforce's report will be released later this year.

key_points.point: Mr Zhulkarnain Abdul Rahim said MSF targets another additional 500 families for the social health integration pilot.
key_points.speaker: Mr Zhulkarnain Abdul Rahim
key_points.quote: We target another additional 500 more.

key_points.point: Mr Zhulkarnain Abdul Rahim said the social health integration pilot is being trialed in three SSO clusters.
key_points.speaker: Mr Zhulkarnain Abdul Rahim
key_points.quote: we are trialing in SSO clusters in: one, Bukit Batok, Bukit Panjang and Choa Chu Kang; two, Sembawang and Woodlands; and three, Tampines, Pasir Ris and Punggol.

key_points.point: Mr Goh Pei Ming said a right to disconnect policy for preschool educators is being worked on.
key_points.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
key_points.quote: this is a policy that we are working now.

key_points.point: Mr Goh Pei Ming said ECDA is starting with the co-creation of a parent-preschool charter.
key_points.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
key_points.quote: we are starting with the co-creation of a parent-preschool charter.

key_points.point: Mr Goh Pei Ming said ECDA moved from capacity-based to enrolment-based funding for Anchor Operator centres.
key_points.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
key_points.quote: We moved from capacity-based to enrolment-based funding

key_points.point: Mr Eric Chua said a Job Redesign Grant can already be applied for under the existing Open Door Programme.
key_points.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
key_points.quote: Under the existing Open Door Programme, there is a Job Redesign Grant that can already be applied for

key_points.point: Mr Eric Chua said MSF is keen to roll out more Enabling Services Hubs across the island in coming years.
key_points.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
key_points.quote: we are very keen to roll out more ESHs over different parts of the island in the coming years

key_points.point: Mr Zhulkarnain Abdul Rahim said MSF continuously monitors ComLink+ and receives feedback from families.
key_points.speaker: Mr Zhulkarnain Abdul Rahim
key_points.quote: We continuously monitor ComLink+ and we receive feedback from families that we serve

key_points.point: Mr Zhulkarnain Abdul Rahim said the FSC caseworker will double up and serve like the family coach to the ComLink+ family.
key_points.speaker: Mr Zhulkarnain Abdul Rahim
key_points.quote: the FSC caseworker will double up and serve like the family coach to the ComLink+ family

key_points.point: Mr Eric Chua said MSF has curated home-based businesses such as Jun Le.
key_points.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
key_points.quote: we have curated a whole host of home-based businesses, such as Jun Le

key_points.point: Mr Xie Yao Quan sought leave to withdraw his amendment.
key_points.speaker: Mr Xie Yao Quan
key_points.quote: I seek leave to withdraw my amendment.

what_happens_next: Mr Xie Yao Quan sought leave to withdraw his amendment; the Taskforce on Assurance for Families with Persons with Disabilities will release its report later this year; several measures have stated start dates, including July 2026 for disability subsidies and January 2027 for the preschool subsidy income ceiling.
not_said: Whether MSF will amend section 12 of the Mental Capacity Act to allow accredited organisations to serve as personal welfare donees.
Whether the LPA registration fee for low-wage foreign workers will be waived or reduced.
How the new ComLink+ milestones will be calibrated in detail.
Whether portable preschool subsidies will be introduced.
Whether a single centralised portal for PwD support will be created.
Whether Singapore Sign Language interpretation will be systematically funded across counselling, social support centres and crisis response services.
Whether a National Disability Job Redesign Fund will be established.
Whether domestic child abduction will get an expedited judicial pathway.
Whether unwed parents will receive the Baby Bonus cash gift or tax benefits.
Whether the right to disconnect policy for preschool educators will be formalised.

_dropped.point: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M said MSF works with industry practitioners to put up a skills fr
_dropped.quote: we put up what we call the skills framework for social service.
